findings.title: Test gap: the typeof-number check in boundProbabilities is not pinned for a valid criteria key
findings.evidence: Mutation on a scratch copy (/dev/shm/ovd637-rev2): removing `typeof p === "number" && ` from scripts/jev-agent-decisions-eval.mjs:64 leaves all 25 tests passing. With that check removed, a numeric string on a real criteria key (for example {reviewer: "0.9"}) passes the `p >= 0 && p <= 1` coercion and would be written as a string. The only string-valued hostile entry in the tests is on `reviewer_extra`, which the key filter already drops. The `Number.isFinite(p)` mutant also survives, but that mutant is equivalent (the range check already rejects NaN and Infinity). Every other mutant was killed: key filter, range, upper, lower, raw usage, negative, integer, raw dup/role probabilities, empty-to-{} and array-as-object.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one assertion, for example `boundProbabilities({ a: "0.5" }, ["a"])` should be null, or put a numeric string on a valid key inside hostileProbabilities.
